The '''2021–22 Texas A&M Aggies men's basketball team''' represented [[Texas A&M University]] during the [[2021–22 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The team was led by third-year head coach [[Buzz Williams]] and played their home games at [[Reed Arena]] in [[College Station, Texas]] as a member of the [[Southeastern Conference]]. They finished the season 27–13, 9–9 in [[2021–22 Southeastern Conference men's basketball season|SEC play]] to finish in a five-way tie for fifth place. As the No. 8 seed in the [[2022 SEC men's basketball tournament|SEC tournament]], they defeated [[2021–22 Florida Gators men's basketball team|Florida]], [[2021–22 Auburn Tigers men's basketball team|Auburn]], and [[2021–22 Arkansas Razorbacks men's basketball team|Arkansas]] to advance to the championship game where they lost to [[2021–22 Tennessee Volunteers basketball team|Tennessee]]. They received an at-large bid to the [[2022 National Invitation Tournament|National Invitation Tournament]] as a No. 1 seed. They defeated [[2021–22 Alcorn State Braves basketball team|Alcorn State]], [[2021–22 Oregon Ducks men's basketball team|Oregon]], [[2021–22 Wake Forest Demon Deacons men's basketball team|Wake Forest]], and [[2021–22 Washington State Cougars men's basketball team|Washington State]] to advance to the NIT championship game, where they lost to [[2021–22 Xavier Musketeers men's basketball team|Xavier]].

==Previous season==
In a season limited due to the ongoing [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]], the [[2020–21 Texas A&M Aggies men's basketball team|Aggies]] finished the [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2020–21 season]] 8–10, 2–8 in [[2020–21 Southeastern Conference men's basketball season|SEC play]] to finish in 13th place. They lost in the first round of the [[2021 SEC men's basketball tournament|SEC tournament]] to [[2020–21 Vanderbilt Commodores men's basketball team|Vanderbillt]].
